item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: If you're making an "also" statement or anything that can be put onto your previous post, please just edit that in. No one's responded to your earlier post anyway, and it helps keep spam down if people don't post more than once in succession (unless the post content is super long, which is not the case here).

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm confused about a few things:
For one, how come Oly didn't see walkway's destruction coming? Even if she was unable to avoid her fall - "panic", as i understand it, is impossible if you've known exactly what's about to happen.

Anyway, i really loved this. Extremely glad that you came back to write the ending. The 4th wall breakage i feel detracted, rather than added, but not enough so to negate the awesomeness.

E:
Also, who's talking to her while she's on the reactor chamber's floor? :=S

item.title: a small factual error
item.content:encoded: The generation of lactic acid in muscles isn't actually the reason your muscles burning when they are overworked, as it is stated early on in the story. It's a common misconception but it just caught my eye and I thought I should mention it. I suggest reworking that sentence.
